entities.summary: Marcos Moshinsky Borodiansky was a Mexican physicist of Ukrainian Jewish origin whose work in the field of elementary particles won him the Prince of Asturias Prize for Scientific and Technical Investigation in 1988 and the UNESCO Science Prize in 1997.
